description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller responsible for managing store branding features in a web application. It handles HTTP requests related to displaying the branding page, saving branding information such as logo images and templates, and removing images. The controller interacts with various services for content management, store management, and reference data, and provides endpoints secured with role-based authorization.

classes.name: StoreBrandingController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling store branding operations including display, update, and logo removal functionalities.

methods.name: displayStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store branding page, setting up the model with store data and templates.

methods.name: saveStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the store's branding images, specifically uploading and storing a new logo.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the selected store template.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove the store logo image from content storage and update store data.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up menu-related model attributes for navigation.
